name: loading-success
title: Loading Success
description: Start the action and wait for the result
usage: <LoadingSuccess onRun={async () => { const response = await fetch("/api/status"); if (!response.ok) throw new Error("HTTP " + response.status); }} />
useCases: In integration settings, an admin tests a connection. The button waits for the server and offers another attempt if the check fails.
In a report, an analyst starts a sync and sees confirmation once the request completes.
task: Start the action and wait for the result
behavior: Return a Promise from onRun. The control shows pending, success or retry based on the result.
